title: Portrait photograph of James A. Cunningham, Jr., Chapter 2 p. 40
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in a suit and tie, captioned "James A. Cunningham, Jr." The text describes the start of Project AQUATONE funding from the Contingency Reserve Fund and Cunningham joining the project staff as administrative officer in May 1955; two other officials' names are redacted.
